title: CalendarEntry
description: The 'conductor' object for a single liturgical date. Specifies season + tone, ranked commemorations, and per-service drawing instructions (which source(s), how many stichera, in which order). Lives at `variable-sources/calendar/YYYY-MM-DD.json` when hand-authored; generated dynamically by `calendar-rules.js` for most dates. Drives `assembler.js`. NOTE: the per-service sub-shapes (`vespers`, `matins`, `liturgy`) are documented loosely in this v1 schema because their internal structure is service-specific and still evolving; tightening them is on the roadmap.

_meta.description: Optional authoring metadata (description, note). Stripped at runtime.

date.description: Gregorian (civil) date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Note the Vespers date-shift: API date = civil evening; content for Vespers comes from the *next* day's calendar entry. See `CLAUDE.md` for the convention.

dayOfWeek.description: Lowercase day of week. Drives weekday vs Saturday vs Sunday branches in the assembler.

julianDate.description: Julian-calendar date for jurisdictions on Old Style. `null` for New-Style-only entries. Old-Style support is on the roadmap (Weeks 4–7 in ASSESSMENT.md §6).

liturgicalContext.description: The liturgical-calendar context for the day.

season.description: Liturgical season — one of the six values emitted by `getLiturgicalSeason`. Single source of truth: `constants/seasons.js`. Used by audit family A and many readers.

weekOfLent.description: Week number of Great Lent (1–6) when `season` is `greatLent`.

specialDay.description: Tag for a special-day class such as `soulSaturday`, `forgivenessSunday`, `palmSunday`, `holyTuesday`, etc.

specialDayIndex.description: Disambiguates within a special-day class (e.g. 2nd vs 3rd Soul Saturday).

tone.description: Weekly Octoechos tone. Saturday Great Vespers uses the tone of the *ending* week, not the upcoming Sunday — see CLAUDE.md.

toneSource.description: Where the tone came from. Common values: `weekly`, `weeklyLenten`, `fixed`, `paschal`.

note.description: Authoring note; rubrical or pastoral context for the season/tone selection.

commemorations.description: Ranked list of what is being commemorated on this date. Order matters: rank 1 is primary; lower-ranked commemorations may be co-celebrated, deferred, or sourced for secondary slots.

source.description: Which book this commemoration is drawn from.

key.description: Dotted-path key into the source. Example: `lent.soulSaturday2`, `march-07`, `tone5.saturday.vespers`.

category.description: Saint category for general-menaion fallback and category-based slot selection. Examples: `martyr`, `hieromartyr`, `monastic`, `apostle`, `hierarch`, `soulSaturday`. See `project_category_based_slots.md` in memory.

vespers.description: Per-service drawing instructions for Vespers. Loosely typed in this v1 schema — sub-fields include `serviceType` ('greatVespers' | 'dailyVespers' | 'all-night-vigil'), `lordICall` (slots/glory/now spec), `prokeimenon`, `aposticha`, `troparia`, `paschalOpening` flag, etc. See `service-structure/great-vespers.json` and any hand-authored `variable-sources/calendar/*.json` for concrete examples.

matins.description: Per-service drawing instructions for Matins. Loosely typed in this v1 schema — sub-fields include kathismata, canon (with `irmos`, `troparia[]`, sometimes `secondCanon`), `sessionalHymnAfterPolyeleios`, `laudsSpec`, etc.

liturgy.description: Per-service drawing instructions for the Divine Liturgy. Loosely typed in this v1 schema — sub-fields include antiphons, troparia/kontakia stack, beatitudes, prokeimenon, epistle, alleluia, gospel, communion hymn, megalynarion.
